scope: Replace Renovate with Dependabot base-image maintenance and a verified ARG updater; no package upgrades or running-container switch

readerPaths: Dependabot configuration -> maintenance guide -> update policy -> CLI manpage or workflow -> reviewed PR
documentationImpact.navigationImpact: Existing maintenance and operations entry points link to the policy and manual
documentationImpact.languageStrategy: German first, equivalent English in each document
documentationImpact.platformAndExampleProof: macOS offline fixtures and official-source discovery; hosted Linux/macOS/Windows contract matrix. Future proposals require native Linux/AMD64 Podman evidence; ARM64 execution remains separate.
documentationImpact.risk: Official source formats can drift; missing metadata blocks proposals. Human review, branch protection and native platform acceptance remain binding.
documentationImpact.reevaluationTrigger: Changed channels, source hosts, signing keys, install mechanisms or permission boundaries

documentationImpact.canonicalSource: Committed migration and repository Git history
documentationImpact.evidence: Renderer check-only/status after content and generated commits

validation.nativePodmanBuild: NotPerformed for configuration migration; required by hosted updater before each generated proposal

actionsPrCreation.reason: GitHub couples PR creation and approval in one repository setting; enabled for the requested PR publisher. The workflow contains no review-approval or merge action; branch rules remain binding.
